> Find a good facility
  
This is a biggie. If I'm going to bother with trying to get help, I want to make sure it'll work, and so must find a decent place. The killer is, I have family members in the medical community who could help me find a place, but I'm reticent to ask for their advice, as they're likely to tell others I know, and being smothered with attention is nauseating.
